source.title: A spectator communicated with a competitor during the competitor's inspection
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, regulation [A5a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A5a) has been updated, giving an exception to competitors who do not gain any advantage from their communication.

While the competitor was inspecting the puzzle, a person from the audience asked if they (the competitor) could solve their (the spectator's) puzzle. The competitor responded with "yes, but later". The competitor did not ask for an extra during the attempt. Technically, they communicated with someone other than the delegate and the judge during his attempt, which would be a violation of [Regulation A5a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A5a).

The regulation, as of February 15th 2023 stated the following:
> A5a) While inspecting or solving the puzzle, the competitor must not communicate with anyone other than the judge or the WCA Delegate. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

The WRC agreed to keep the result as it would be too harsh to DNF it, given that the competitor was just being kind with the young spectator. Furthermore, no advantage was gained from the communication. The regulation was also proposed to be more lenient for the next regulation cycle, to reflect this decision.

translation.title: 观众在选手观察时与其交谈
translation.content:
说明：截至 2025 年，[A5a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A5a) 已更新，为未从交流中获益的选手提供例外。

选手观察魔方时，一名观众询问能否帮忙还原自己的魔方。选手回答“可以，但要等会儿”。选手未在尝试中申请额外尝试。从字面上看，他在尝试中与代表、裁判以外的人交流，违反了 [A5a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A5a)。

截至 2023 年 2 月 15 日，该规则规定：
> A5a：观察或还原时，选手不得与裁判或 WCA 代表以外的人交流，否则 DNF。

WRC 同意保留成绩，因为选手只是在友善回应年轻观众，判 DNF 过于严厉，且交流未带来优势。WRC 也提议下一轮规则修订应更宽缓，以体现这一决定。
